title: Anthropic Says It Will Revolutionize Biology—Some Day
summary: In breathless press releases and posts, the company has touted its models’ ability to deliver scientific breakthroughs. But its IPO filing taps the brakes on just how fast its AI will lead to big discoveries.
reason: Wired commentary/critique of Anthropic's public claims about biology breakthroughs and cautious IPO-filing language. No named model release (R1), no research artifact (R2), no concrete financing/deal/partnership announcement to anchor an industry event (R3), and no policy action or OSS tool.
